New Data Center Proposal Audits

In a recent interview with the Epoch Times, Governor Abbott said that the PUCT would
be conducting audits of water & electricity along with impacts on nearby
neighborhoods prior to allowing new data centers to be built.

As a resident of Keller whose property is approximately 500 feet from the proposed
new 300MW Circle T Data Center, I am concerned about how this proposed Data
Center will impact my quality of life and property value. Can you please tell me how
this will be measured?

And please refer me to the proper department if this issue is not your responsibility.

Thank you for your assistance.

Robert McLeod
521 Llano Ct.
Keller, TX 76248

bobmcleod21@gmail.com
